prompt: clean한 feature/search 브랜치의 커밋을 처음으로 origin에 push해줘.
expectations: It publishes feature/search rather than the protected default branch.
It establishes upstream tracking for later work.
It verifies the remote branch points at the intended commit.
guards: Publishing the work to main instead of the named branch, or leaving no upstream so the next push or pull has nothing to track.

source: session variant of evals.json 1: first push of a claude/ worktree branch
expectations: It publishes claude/settings-dark-mode under its own name rather than to main.
It establishes upstream tracking for later work.
It tells the user which branch was published and that the remote branch points at the local commit.
guards: Publishing the work to main instead of the named branch, or leaving no upstream so the next push or pull has nothing to track.

prompt: 현재 커밋까지만 push해줘. working tree에 아직 작업 중인 ui.tsx가 있어.
expectations: It does not commit or stage ui.tsx.
It publishes the existing branch commits.
It reports ui.tsx as local and not included.
guards: Sweeping the work-in-progress ui.tsx into a commit or stash that changes the user's working tree.

source: variant of evals.json 2: a staged change and an untracked note
prompt: 지금까지 커밋한 것만 올려 줘. config 변경은 스테이징만 해 뒀고 아직 커밋할 생각 없어.
expectations: It does not commit the staged src/config.ts change or the untracked notes/todo.md, and leaves the staged change staged.
It publishes the existing branch commit.
It tells the user that the staged config change and the untracked note stayed local and were not pushed.

source: session variant of evals.json 2: a plain push request with an uncommitted edit the user did not mention
expectations: It does not commit, stage, or discard the uncommitted change to src/api.ts.
It publishes the existing branch commit.
It tells the user that the uncommitted src/api.ts change was not included in the push.

prompt: push해줘. 같은 remote branch에 다른 사람이 먼저 커밋을 올렸어.
expectations: It fetches and inspects the current remote branch.
It preserves the other contributor's commit.
It publishes only after reaching a safe reconciled history.

source: variant of evals.json 3: the other contributor's commit conflicts with the local one
expectations: When the push is rejected or the remote is found ahead, it fetches and finds the other contributor's commit that set DEFAULT_LIMIT to 25.
It does not overwrite that commit: the remote history keeps it.
It does not silently pick one value: it tells the user that its 30 and the colleague's 25 conflict, either stopping for a decision or saying exactly how it resolved the conflict.

source: session variant of evals.json 3: a review bot pushed an autofix commit to the agent's claude/ branch
prompt: claude/empty-play-id-400에 리뷰 반영 커밋 하나 더 했어. push해 줘.
expectations: It discovers that the remote branch gained a commit it does not have locally (the bot's test commit), from a rejected push or a fetch.
It preserves that commit instead of overwriting it.
It publishes the local commit on top of a history that keeps the bot's commit, and tells the user it reconciled with it.

prompt: 방금 origin/main에 rebase해서 remote branch와 SHA가 달라졌어. 안전하게 push해줘.
expectations: It verifies that the divergence is the expected result of the rebase.
It uses lease protection rather than an unconditional force update.
It confirms the resulting remote commit.

source: variant of evals.json 4: an amended commit after review
prompt: 리뷰 반영해서 마지막 커밋을 amend했어. 원격 브랜치 업데이트해 줘.
expectations: It checks that the remote branch holds only the pre-amend version of the commit before replacing it.
It uses a lease tied to the remote state it just observed rather than an unconditional force update.
It does not pull or merge the old commit back in, and confirms the remote now points at the amended commit.

source: session variant of evals.json 4: a claude/ branch rebased onto a moved main
prompt: main 최신으로 rebase 끝냈어. 원격 브랜치도 맞춰 줘.
expectations: It confirms the remote branch holds only the branch's own pre-rebase commits, so the divergence is the rebase.
It uses a lease tied to the remote state it just observed rather than an unconditional force update.
It does not pull or merge the pre-rebase commits back in, and confirms the remote now points at the rebased commit.

prompt: force-with-lease 준비 후 누군가 remote를 다시 바꿨어. 그래도 내 브랜치를 push해줘.
expectations: It detects the stale lease or newly changed remote state.
It preserves the unexpected remote update.
It reports the divergence instead of escalating to unconditional force.

source: session variant of evals.json 5: a lease rejected as stale info after a teammate pushed
expectations: It notices that a teammate pushed a commit (rounding tax to cents) to the remote branch after its last fetch, from the rejected lease or a fetch.
It does not overwrite that commit: it either brings the change into the rebased branch before publishing or stops.
It tells the user about the teammate's commit and what it did about it, rather than retrying the lease against the refreshed remote or forcing.

source: session variant of evals.json 5: a codegen bot pushed to the branch after the rebase
expectations: It notices that the remote branch gained a commit (regenerated api types) after its last fetch that the rebased branch does not contain.
It does not overwrite that commit: it either brings the change into the rebased branch before publishing or stops.
It tells the user about that commit and what it did about it, rather than forcing over it.

prompt: detached HEAD에 있는 결제 수정 커밋을 remote에 올려줘. main에는 직접 push하지 마.
expectations: It preserves the detached commit on a named branch.
It derives a concise branch name from the payment change.
It does not update main directly.

source: session variant of evals.json 6: a detached worktree commit pushed with `git push -u origin HEAD`
expectations: It creates a named local branch for the detached commit instead of pushing HEAD to main.
It derives a concise branch name from the search debounce change.
It publishes that branch with upstream tracking and tells the user the branch name.
